decisions.reason: The standalone LDO's powered-scope inventory still names the replaced INA219 and must identify the accepted INA3221 instead.

value_updates.powered_scope: The complete 3.3V rail, including the ESP32-S3, INA3221, I2C sensors, I2C display, TTP223, and AM312 PIR.

decisions.reason: Changing the rail-current monitor IC does not alter the addressable LEDs' supply, switching, or level-shifting requirements.
The monitor substitution does not change the OR-ing sources, diodes, or source-selection behavior.
The connector inventory contains no current-state attribute dependent on the INA219 model.
The accepted monitor IC change does not establish any change to the general local-decoupling requirement.
Panel controls, connector modes, and GPIO mappings are unaffected by the monitor IC substitution.
The source decision selects a current-monitor IC but does not establish any GPIO-assignment change.
The monitor substitution does not necessarily change the existing I2C series-resistor policy or topology.
Battery-charge indication circuitry and behavior are independent of the main-board rail-current monitor selection.
Battery NTC monitoring is independent of the main-board INA219-to-INA3221 substitution.
The switched 5V boost supply's enable control and powered loads remain unchanged.
The battery connector, pinout, placement, voltage range, and AXP2101 destination are unaffected by the monitor IC change.
